report:
[ORACLE] - ORA-01013

Hi,
Hope this message finds you well.
Lately, our CDC process has been returning the same error, after a few days of streaming: Error Msg = ORA-01013: user requested cancel of current operation
Is there any way to mitigate this?
Best regards

evidence.quote: we introduced database.query.timeout.ms, which applies a blanket 10 minute timeout on all queries ... therefore the driver triggers ORA-01013 when the query has exceeded this threshold.

notes: ORA-01013 looks like a DB/driver fault but is Debezium's own default 10-minute query timeout; fix is config. The timeout wiring in JdbcConnection/LogMiner query settles it.

reviews.fix: Raise or disable the connector's database.query.timeout.ms (default 10-minute cap causes ORA-01013).
reviews.evidence: Chris Cranford: "Set `database.query.timeout.ms` to a value longer than 10 minutes ... Set `database.query.timeout.ms` to `0`, to turn off query timeouts"
reviews.boundary: B vs C: the timeout is a deliberate Debezium setting in the connector's own config, so B not C; reporter only said he would try it.
